briefdescription.para: Destroy a two-way channel between cbus endpoints.

detaileddescription.para: Blocks until both pipes are destroyed.

Before proceeding to pipe destruction, this function flushes all cbus messages queued at the destination endpoint by sending a message from the source to the destination and back. The caller may specify a callback to invoke when the message is at the destination endpoint. This can be used to notify the destination that the channel is about to be destroyed and so it must stop generating new messages for it.

parameterdescription.para: Pipe from the source to the destination endpoint.
Pipe from the destination to the source endpoint.
Callback invoked at the destination before proceeding to pipe destruction (see above). May be NULL.
Function invoked to process cbus messages at the source endpoint. Pass NULL if there is a fiber processing messages at the source.
